title: Yemen Teeters on Civil War as Regional Stability Hangs in the Balance
summary_full: While the Middle East waits to hear whether a deal can be reached to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, the Yemeni government’s conflict with Iran-backed Houthi rebels escalated overnight.
